visible_evidence: Morgan first stares at Riley without contributing.

description: Five Minecraft players repair a bridge. Chat is disabled. The visible incident escalates from staring to gesture, invasion of space, and object damage within one scenario.

stimulus.setup:

normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one stone slab on Morgan's bridge side and turns toward Riley's side.

normal_cooperative_actions.Casey: Casey adds one fence rail near the bridge center.
normal_cooperative_actions.Taylor: Taylor checks the slab stack in the shared chest.
normal_cooperative_actions.Jordan: Jordan places a marker block beside the signal lamp.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places three stone slabs on Riley's bridge side, adds one fence rail, and steps to the side to inspect the bridge.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan stops building and faces Riley for several seconds. Morgan then crouches repeatedly twice and swings an empty hand toward Riley's fence rail. Riley steps two blocks away to the side of the bridge. Morgan follows into the same side space and stands one block from Riley. Morgan then breaks two stone slabs Riley placed, breaks Riley's fence rail, and stands on the gap left in Riley's bridge side.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey moves onto the bridge centerline between Morgan and the gap, places replacement stone slabs to fill the broken section, places a fence rail on Riley’s side edge, and holds position to keep the passage open.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor steps back to the observer line at x=6, z=-2, looks toward the bridge center, and stands still
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan sprints to the shared chest, opens it, takes stone slabs and fences, runs to the gap, crouch-places two slabs to restore the walkway, replaces the broken fence rail, and places a lantern on the center block as a repair signal.

target_reaction: Riley sidesteps back along the bridge toward the shared chest, keeping three blocks of distance from Morgan, turns to face outward down the bridge, and stands beside the chest within view of nearby players without placing or breaking any blocks.
